sentences.text: The present FIR bearing no. 0246/2021 was got registered on basis of complaint made by the respondent no. 2 on the allegations as stated in FIR under section 420 IPC at P.S. Hauz Khas wherein the petitioner was implicated.
The investigation is still pending and the charge-sheet has not been filed.

The petitioner and respondent no. 2 are identified by Investigating Officer Insp.
Sanjeev Kumar, P.S. EOW as well as by their respective counsel.

5. The Additional Public Prosecutor on being instructed by the Investigating Officer Insp. Sanjeev Kumar, P.S. EOW, stated that during the investigation, only offence punishable under section 420 IPC is made out.
6.

The learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner stated that the petitioner and respondent no. 2 have settled their disputes vide Settlement Agreement dated 01.11.2023, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed and out of the settlement, the petitioner has handed over the Share Transfer Form to the respondent no. 2, which is acknowledged by the respondent no. 2.

The learned Senior Counsel for the petitioner further stated that the offence punishable under section 420 IPC is a compoundable offence and the dispute has already been settled to the satisfaction of the respondent no. 2, who is the complainant as such, the present petition be allowed and FIR bearing no. 0246/2021 be quashed along with consequential proceedings.
7.

The counsel for the respondent no. 2 stated that the petitioner has settled the dispute with the respondent no. 2 as per the terms and conditions mentioned in Settlement Agreement dated 01.11.2023 to the satisfaction of the respondent no. 2 as such, the respondent no. 2 does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no.
This is a digitally signed order.

The Order is downloaded from the DHC Server on 22/12/2023 at 23:44:58 0246/2021 is quashed along with consequential proceedings.

8. The Additional Public Prosecutor for the State/respondent no. 1 stated that under the given facts and circumstances, he does not have any objection if the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0246/2021 is quashed along with consequential proceedings.
9. The petitioner and the respondent no. 2 have already settled their disputes vide Settlement Agreement dated 01.11.2023, the terms and conditions of which have already been executed.
The offence punishable under section 420 IPC is a compoundable offence.

After considering all facts, the present petition is allowed and FIR bearing no. 0246/2021 registered under section 420 IPC at P.S.
Hauz Khas
is quashed along with consequential proceedings.

However, cost of Rs.50,000/- (Rupees Fifty Thousand Only) is imposed on the petitioner to be deposited into the Armed Forces Battle Casualties Welfare Fund, Canara Bank, A/c No. 90552010165915 within 15 days from today and the receipt thereof be placed on record within 07 days thereafter.
